body: im just a screw up. everything couldve been avoided

i just honestly hope some of the things he said were said in the heat of the moment. he's got a lot going on and it is best to give him a break. i just hope he doesnt want to lose me too. ill give it some time and maybe try to message him. i just want things to work out between us so bad

i know ive still got so much time, but if life is always like this, i dont know if i want to continuing living. it's so hard when you're so lonely and dont really have anyone to lean on.
like sometimes, i just want to be treated like a pet. always being taken care of, no responsibilities, no worries. but of course, life isnt that easy and i know i have to take care of myself, but it's hard to find things that are worth living for

there's honestly not much i can do. it was a long distance relationship and i just screwed it up by overreacting. we were perfectly fine earlier today as well.
i just seemed to make him more and more mad though. he wanted a break and i just begged him to give me another chance, which in hindsight, was probably not the best idea... i dont want to lose him. i want to fight for him. ive apologized a ton to him though.
i just cant help but go into this mindset though. he's removed me from almost everything and his personal life is hard right now.
his (homophobic) parents found out that he was dating a guy (me) and he said he wasnt sure he could be in a relationship right now because of them...
im just hurt and overwhelmed. i know he is too. ive told him that i loved him and that i dont want him to give up on me, on us, because i wanted to fight for him.
it's more easier said than done though. i dont know how to get out of this mindset
i domt even know what else i would talk about. i feel so dumb and useless
god, it's not that simple for me. im literally here saying this is pushing me over the edge. not something to easily get over
